Python's primary sequence type. Think of them as ordered, expandable shopping lists where you can add, remove, or modify items at any time.
Lists fundamentals.
Item maintain their exact insertion sequence.

Store data in labeled key-value pairs. Instead of accessing elements using numerical positions, it looks up values using unique descriptive keys.
Unique identifiers used to lookup values inside a dictionary.
Data stored associated with specific keys.

Strings in Python are ordered, immutable sequences of characters. Because strings share sequence mechanics with lists, many indexing and slicing techniques apply directly to text.
